note: Per-token P_in/P_out for prereg 5.2 are NOT published by Modal; they must be DERIVED as gpu_usd_per_sec / throughput_tokens_per_sec (prefill throughput for P_in, decode throughput for P_out). Absolute GPU rate cancels in the analysis (dollar grid is c_j = P_out*B_j); only P_in/P_out = decode_tps/prefill_tps affects results.
